title: Work order
description: A single unit of code/file/system work that Hermes, or the operator through OpenJarvis's Dispatch action (hq 0023), asks Claude Code to perform. Written to _data/workorders/pending/<id>.json. One-way: the issuer never receives anything back except the report.

id.description: Unique for all time. The dispatcher rejects any id it has already reported on.

issuedBy.description: hermes: written by Hermes's submit_work_order tool. operator: written by OpenJarvis as the operator's own click on a delegate row (hq 0023 D2).

planRef.description: Where this order came from, for tracing: a Hermes plan or task, or approvals:<kind>:<id> for an operator dispatch from the waiting list (hq 0023).

repo.description: Key into the dispatcher's repo map. Never a raw path.

scope.description: read-only: investigate and report, no changes. edit: changes are made on a new branch in a separate worktree and left for human review. Nothing is ever pushed, merged, or deployed by a work order.

context.description: Optional background: data Hermes observed, the waiting row's source feed and scope, links, prior report ids.

supersedes.description: Id of an earlier order this one retries. If that order did not finish as done, the operator must have approved the retry in workorders/approvals/<this id>.ok.
